title: Kompas full-cycle: quantified correction, re-entry, altseason ignition and exit
question: Perform an adversarial cross-archive research synthesis, not a generic plan. Which exact Task2 R0-R7/PIT first-known, H18 pullback timing/depth, M6/EDGE001 false-warning/economic, RQS rebound, M4 ETHBTC rotation survival, breadth/flow, CN and TechDev-challenger analyses must be actually executed to build reliable Kompas Pullback Radar + Altseason takeoff and distribution/exit? Separate onset probability (only if calibrated), depth, time to trough, recovery duration, holder/cash re-entry decisions, alt-tier stress, and ordinary bull correction versus bear regime. Produce an 8-12 experiment executable matrix with precise asset/time universe, source path + clock, source gap, independent denominator, preregistered outcome, price-only/HOLD comparators, controls, effect/kill criterion, original owner & smallest code/test changes; rank Top 3 cheapest high-value repairs, exact source code paths, PR/CI/Pages wiring and rollout. Altseason: assess BTC dominance ex-stables vs total, ETH/BTC base depth/persistence, breadth survival, stablecoin deployment, ETF flows, spot-vs-derivatives/OI funding crowding, microcap sellability and risk; quantify false ignition, exit timing opportunity cost and missed upside. TechDev #104 2026-11-03 case is only external dated challenger, do not copy paywalled material or infer unique predictive skill from selected example. Scientifically assess which features must remain UNKNOWN/SHADOW. A research verdict alone is NOT a live signal or merge.
hypothesis: Source-legal multi-family event timing, drawdown-depth/holding duration and rotation-survival signals may improve timely correction/re-entry and altseason exit decisions relative to simple price/volatility/HOLD, but historical PIT, small-N fake ETHBTC breakouts, stale warnings and correlated sensors may eliminate all apparent edge.
baseline: B0 same-clock naive price/volatility / always HOLD/no-warning; B1 ETHBTC-only; B2 existing Official Compass/Pullback Radar/M6/forward path; B3 pre-registered cross-family challenger with equal data availability and alert budget. Economic side holder-vs-cash distinct with friction, missed upside and opportunity cost.
falsifier: No independent source/PIT or fewer independent families than required; false alerts/re-entries, failed ETHBTC rotations, correlation or cherry-picked TechDev examples explain results; after-cost advantage is zero/negative; depth/ETA can't beat empirical excursion/survival controls; broad altseason false exits cost more than protected drawdown.
kill_condition: If authentic historical first-known/decision/delivery clocks, independent families, after-cost fills or enough matured prospective rows are unavailable, explicitly output INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, candidate shadow tests and cheapest source repair; never invent live odds, exact dates, trade permissions or profit.
forbidden: model weights or risk thresholds without independent governance
